summary: Phase 7 Inventory Intelligence + P3 bug fixes fully verified. Backend: 13/13 pytest passing after fixing an async-iteration bug in dealer_stock_ageing report. Frontend: dashboard, scan+toast, alerts (raise/filter/resolve), 4 report tabs, replenishment (QA-INTEL-TEST recommendation + advisory note) all functional. Bug1 (cookie banner not overlapping /login CTA) and Bug2 (/memberships/members deep link renders console with members tab; /memberships defaults to dashboard; /memberships/setup renders wizard) both PASS.
action_items: None — all P7 features and both P3 bug fixes verified. Testing agent fixed a real backend bug in inventory_intelligence.py (see updated_files); main agent should be aware of that change.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: routes/inventory_intelligence.py line 172 used `async for h in cursor.find(...).to_list(1000)` which raises TypeError because to_list() returns a Future/list, not an async iterator. Changed to plain `async for h in cursor.find(...)`. Confirmed via failing pytest -> passing.

Minor: intel/scan endpoint deletes all existing 'new' alerts on every scan; if a user assigned an alert to themselves in the split-second before the sweep runs, that state change would still survive (status != new). Acceptable, but consider documenting.

Minor: 'Low available stock' Inventory Risk alert triggers at avail<=1 while replenishment default reorder_point=2 — mismatched thresholds mean replenishment can recommend restock without a corresponding monitoring alert. Consider aligning.
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/inventory_intelligence.py (fixed async iteration bug on dealer_stock_ageing report)
seed_data_creation: Created warehouse QA-INTEL-WH and stock holding QA-INTEL-TEST (qty 1) under org iso-demo-org. Cleaned up post-test: 1 holding, 1 movement, 2 alerts, 1 warehouse deleted from Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_intelligence_phase7.py can be re-run any time; it self-seeds QA-INTEL-* data (does not currently auto-cleanup — teardown was done manually). Owner login is rate-limited (429 after ~4 rapid logins) — reuse tokens.
rca of the issue: GET /api/inventory/intel/reports/dealer_stock_ageing returned 500. Root cause: `async for h in db.dealer_inventory_holdings.find(...).to_list(1000)` — motor's .to_list() returns an awaitable/list, not an async iterator, so `async for` raises TypeError. Fix: remove `.to_list(1000)` and iterate the AsyncIOMotorCursor directly. Verified with pytest and via UI (report tab renders without crash).
